name: thinkube-tandem
description: Tandem — ground-truth-first pair development. You say what you want in your words; the machine grounds it in the code, you sign the cut, workers build from exact work orders, and you accept the delivery by experiencing it.

thinkubeTandem.storeRoot.description: Root of the tandem store — spaces persist at <root>/spaces/<workspace>. Empty uses ~/thinkube-tandem-store.

thinkubeTandem.groundingModel.description: Model for the grounding round (judgment stage).

thinkubeTandem.suiteCommand.description: Command that runs the project's test suite — its verdict is a delivery proof.

thinkubeTandem.giteaToken.description: API token for the platform's Gitea forge. Unused for github.com remotes.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && cd webview/map && npm run build
